chat.t: Hehe, Mr. Fixer.
Last night was absolutely amazing...
Right?

o: Amazing? What are you talking about?

chat.t: Backing out now...?
Even after you gave me a Free Request Ticket.

o: That has nothing to do with this.
Anyway, call me when you actually have work, not when you're just bored.

chat.t: Alright! What kind of request should we do...?

o: Let me repeat, the freebie is only a one-time thing.

chat.t: Is it?
You never know...

o: What?

chat.t: Just kidding, just kidding!

lines.t: Mmm...
Something warm and... squishy...
...Breasts?
*Squish—*
Mmm...? Your hands are being quite naughty.
That's a pretty rough wake-up call.
Is this a dream?
Either way, I'm touching them more.
Ah... Don't squeeze them so hard...
Since it's just a dream anyway, shouldn't I be allowed to touch you as much as I want?
Hmm... A dream, you say?
...Heh!
Arghhh!!
Heh, well? Wide awake now? Does it still feel like a dream?
Thanks to you. Since it hurts, I guess it's not a dream.
More importantly, who are you?
How cruel... After we spent such a passionate night together yesterday...
Are you always this cold in the morning?
Don't change the subject.
What, do you really not remember?
Try hard to remember... What did we do together yesterday?
*Hic*... Ugh, I feel sick.
But if beer is bottomless, you've got to drink as much as possible.
But what on earth is that sound?
Huh... She's pretty good on the guitar...
You there... Yeah, you.
Me?
Yes, you... Why don't you come over here for a second?
What does this look like to you?
...An electric guitar?
Heh... This is what you call a <bouten>bass</bouten>.
Was that a bit too difficult of a question?
Like I care.
Ugh... You reek of alcohol... You're just a drunkard!
I'll let it slide this once since you're drunk.
*Hic* If it's long and has strings, it's a guitar!
How many strings did a guitar have again?
A guitar has six!
Right! Let's see...
One... two... three... four...
Ugh, I'm so drunk I can't see the other two.
That's because this isn't a guitar, it's a bass.
It only has four strings!
Does having fewer strings make it easier to play?
Not really!
Give it here.
I want to try playing it.
What? Don't be unreasonable...!
To a musician, their instrument is like their own life!
You can entrust your life to someone else once in a while!

I'll use it carefully and return it...
Gwaaaagh!!
Aaaaagh!!!!
And so, you dragged me here, telling me to wash up...
And then, things happened...
Yesterday... well, yeah, that happened.
Now then... shall we discuss the compensation for the laundry bill and the emotional distress?
I don't have any money!
No way!
Oh, so you're going to be shameless about it?
Works for me! I'll just live here until I'm fully compensated.
It's quite spacious and nice! You'll cover all the living expenses and chores, right?
W-W-Wait a minute! I absolutely refuse to take in any more freeloaders!
Mmm-hmm... What's wrong?
And here I was, just about to announce a hiatus...
Do you even know what I do for a living?
Well... A drunkard?
...I solve all kinds of problems that crop up here and there.
I'm a Fixer of sorts. A highly competent one, at that.
Hmm... A Fixer?
So, I'll give you a Free Request Ticket.
Whenever you call, I'll prioritize you! Even if I have to drop everything else!
Well, alright... But on one condition.
What condition?
I get to decide when the request is complete.
Otherwise, you might slack off and insist you finished it.
Though, if you did that, I'd just have to move in here...
Tch...
You really have trust issues... Fine, okay.
Haha! Great! I'll be in your care, Mr. Fixer!

chat.t: Hey there!
I finally have a request for you.

o: I was hoping you'd forgotten about it by now.

chat.t: Not a chance!

o: So, what's the job?

chat.t: I'll tell you when you meet me.

o: Must be a pretty tough job.

chat.t: It's just easier to show you than to explain!
You're super competent, so you'll do a perfect job, right?

o: Of course.

chat.t: Then let's meet in front of the station!
The stalker really did disappear!
I didn't feel anyone watching me on my way back.

o: Works like a charm, right?
Then that's the end of your free request.

chat.t: But I have no idea what you actually did!

o: What kind of logic is that?!

chat.t: You didn't solve it in front of me!
They might have vanished for some other reason!

o: Donut House is run by the police.
They probably got arrested for lurking around suspiciously with a knife!

chat.t: Even if they did, they'd just be sent to the Panoticon.
Won't they be out in a single day?

o: ...Tch. You really don't let anything slide.

chat.t: You shouldn't cut corners on your work!
I'll be counting on you tomorrow as well!

o: Damn it! What a crappy world where you can't even get an easy win!

lines.t: In front of the station
10 minutes later
30 minutes later
Ah, sorry, sorry! Am I a bit late?
Do I look okay to you?!
Who calls someone out and then shows up 40 minutes late?!
I said I'm sorry! What was I supposed to do when my bed grabbed onto me and wouldn't let go?
Bonding with my bed is a very important task!
I want to roll around in bed too, you know!
Then you shouldn't have made that mistake... Ah, I can still see my ruined clothes flashing before my eyes...
...Tch. Fine, I get it.
Fufu... Anyway, I won't be late next time, so cheer up.
Next time?
Well, who knows? Maybe you won't be able to get the job done right.
We won't know until we try.
So, what's the actual job?
Ah, about that... I think I have a stalker.
So, get rid of them for me!
A stalker...?
They even followed me today. Look over there.
Lately, they've been following me around quite obviously.
I left them alone because it was too much hassle, but then they tried to break into my house.
...Why are you acting like it's no big deal?
I mean, it is a serious issue, but...
But?
It's too much work.
Reporting them... finding them... cleaning up the mess...
Ah, I'm tired just thinking about it.
You'll probably find keeping yourself alive too much work, too.
Whoa... How did you know?
I seriously wish I could just leave it to someone else sometimes.
And yet you said you wouldn't hand over your guitar.
It's not a guitar, it's a bass!
And besides, that is my spirit and my soul!
I really don't see the difference...
Anyway, what kind of stalker are we dealing with?
They seem to hate it when I talk to other people.
I heard they even chased someone with a kitchen knife.
...Hey. Doesn't that put me in danger too?
Oh, please. At most you'll get a little scratch. What could they possibly do with a cheap kitchen knife?
Getting scratched still hurts!!
Haha! That's exactly why I asked you!
The highly competent Mr. Fixer, who can solve anything.
Sigh... First, let's verify if they're actually following us.
Sounds good!
DD STATION
Why did we have to come here of all places?
It's way too noisy here, I hate it.
Wandering around aimlessly is worse, isn't it?
Alright, let's try this first.
What is this?
A guitar rhythm game.
I keep telling you! I'm a bassist!
There's a four-string guitar here too.
You... you're doing this on purpose, aren't you?
Doing what?
Sigh... Never mind.
Then let's have some fun.
Whoa, you really are good.
I could do this with my eyes closed.
So, are they still following us?
They're over there.
Shall we move somewhere else then?
Still following?
Behind that lamppost...
And now?
Glaring at us from behind the tree.
No way, even here?
Sitting at that table over there.
I can't see them at all, but you spot them so easily.
That's because their glare is getting more and more intense.
Heh, everything is going exactly according to plan.
This is all part of your plan?
It feels like you're just dragging me along to play.
Aw, you're just imagining things.
This is all a necessary process to max out their rage gauge.
So do you actually have a way to solve this?
Of course. Our next stop is the final destination.
Why did we come here?
No need for long explanations.
Hurry up and go buy some donuts.
Wait, me?
Yeah. It has to be you.
Make sure to have a brief, friendly chat with the staff, too.
Ah, what a pain...
I'll give you the money.
That's not the issue here...
It's a necessary step to complete the request, so stop complaining.
Well, if you're going that far...
Now all we have to do is wait, and it'll be solved.
I'm back! There was some kind of ruckus near the entrance just now... Did something happen?
Oh, it's nothing. Shall we head back then?
Is that it? What about the stalker?
I've solved it perfectly.
I don't get it at all...
It just shows how competent I am.

chat.t: Are you awake?

o: Ugh... 'Miracle Morning' is not in my dictionary.

chat.t: Same here!

o: Then let's settle this in front of the Panoticon.

chat.t: Got it!

o: If they got locked up because of me, you have to count that as request complete.

chat.t: I told you, that doesn't count as solving it!
Oh, right.

o: What is it?

chat.t: I'll invite you to the next Girls Storm show.

o: Is it expensive?

chat.t: No, it's a street live!
But I'll get you the absolute best spot. Front row. Up close and personal.

o: I'll think about it.

chat.t: We dance while we sing, so you might catch a glimpse under our skirts...?

o: Tell me the date and location right now. I'm clearing my schedule.

chat.t: You really are so easy to read!

lines.t: In front of the Panoticon
Hey. Congrats on getting released.
You... you!!! How dare you trap me!!
What trap?
Don't play dumb! I can't believe the donut sellers were police officers!
Is there anyone in Humanitas who doesn't know that?
Ah, are you perhaps not from Humanitas?
I'm from Vermont! There's no way I would know that!!
People from other cities know this much too... You really don't pay attention to anything in the world.
Anyway, it seems you did end up in the Panoticon thanks to me.
But that still doesn't mean the request is complete, does it?
Damn it!
Oh my muse! My goddess! You came all this way just for me!
Ah... Your halo is so bright, I can't see...
...This is a severe case. If we leave them alone, they'll keep stalking you forever.
What a hassle, seriously...
A hassle...?
I, who bought every single Girls Storm album and followed you to every concert...
Quit my job, moved to Humanitas, and did nothing but follow you around...
Am I just a hassle?!
Yes, a hassle. I wish you'd stop following me.
How could you say something so cruel...!!
If we leave them be, they're definitely going to cause trouble. A physical beatdown is the only cure for guys like this.
Sera, take them out.
Eh?!
Me? Physically?
Ah, that's a reward...
Ugh. Now I definitely don't want to do it.
I can't fight, and this is the only way.
Sigh... And then what?
Leave that to me. I'll make sure it's taken care of.
Sigh... Alright.
Hehehehe, hehe...
Ugh... They really were a total weirdo.
This confirms it. That girl is just a run-of-the-mill masochist pervert.
No! Not if it's not my Muse...!!
That's probably because you haven't tasted true stimulation yet. I actually happen to know someone who will shower you with love.
No, that's not true! I don't want a one-sided, abusive love!!
Love is something I seek out myself! Something I win over!!
Listen to this stalker talk. What kind of bullshit logic is that?
The pain and frustration that come with rejection... that's part of the pleasure too...! Hehehe...!
Don't try to sound romantic, you pathetic pervert stalker.
Hey, Head Maid?! Yeah, I've got a criminal here who wants to become your personal chair...
Having received the call, the Head Maid arrived and dragged the stalker away as an active offender.
And with that, it's over! Do you admit it?
But won't they be out of there in just a day anyway...?
Well... With a masochist pervert of that level, the moment the Head Maid gets her hands on them, they won't even think of you anymore.
It looked like they were still a bit confused about their own identity.
Now they'll probably keep going in and out of the Panoticon to pester the Head Maid instead of you.
Hmm... Is that so? But what about the Head Maid then?
Who cares, she's rich, she can deal with it herself.
Hmm... I see...
I'll admit it! You really are a competent Fixer.
With that, the Free Request Ticket is used up. Next time you have a favor to ask, it's going to cost you, got it?
Sure. If another annoying problem pops up, I'll call you again.
Make sure you have plenty of money ready.
Okay.
Well, I should head back to keep building my friendship with my bed!
After that, I received a rather resentful request from the Head Maid.
Complaining that the stalker keeps ending up in the Panoticon on purpose...

I make money, and I solve the requests.
Bwahahaha!!
